entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Ms. Sapna Lunkad, learned counsel for the appl
 Ms. Sophiya Khan, learned Penal Lawyer for the
State.
Heard on the question of admission.

The applicant has been convicted under the provisions of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act by JMFC, Badnawar, District Dhar and the order of conviction has been upheld by the learned appellate Court vide judgement dated 27.04.2019 passed in Criminal Appeal No.632/2010 wherein the applicant has been sentenced for six months R.I. with fine of Rs.1,000/- for committing adulteration and equivalent sentence for mis-branding the articles.
After due consideration, the appeal is admitted for final hearing.
Also heard on I.A. No.3426/2019 an application for suspension of jail sentence.

Counsel for the applicant submits a citation of the apex Court in the case of Nemi Chand vs. State of Rajasthan (2016) 2 AICLR 479 in which it has been held that in a case when the appellant convicted under the provisions of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, he may be dealt with as per the provisions of Food, Safety and Adulteration Act, 2006 and be subjected to only penalty of depositing a sum of money instead of jail term.

entities.text: Nemi Chand vs. State of Rajasthan (2016) 2 AICLR 479
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel submits that considering this judgment, jail sentence be suspended.
The applicant has been found guilty by both the courts below, hence, it would be appropriate to call for the record.
The citation of apex Court may be useful at the time of final submissions and this matter may even be taken up for consideration finally at motion stage.
Presently, the record of the courts below needs to be requisitioned.
As the applicant is in jail, record of the Courts below be requisitioned immediately so that the case may be listed in the next week.
Matter be listed immediately after receiving the record.
